# Sigra v1.20.0 - Table of Contents

Authentication for Phoenix 1.8+ and Ecto. Mix generators emit host-owned auth (sessions, Argon2id, TOTP, passkeys, encryption, audit). OAuth, mailers, Oban, and more are optional host deps. See https://hexdocs.pm/sigra and the README for details.

## Modules

- [Sigra.A11y.Contrast](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.A11y.Contrast.md): WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio calculator for deterministic accessibility assertions.
- [Sigra.APIToken](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.APIToken.md): Core API token operations: creation, verification, revocation, and scope checks.
- [Sigra.APIToken.ScopeRegistry](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.APIToken.ScopeRegistry.md): Scope validation and registry for API tokens.
- [Sigra.Account](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Account.md): Account lifecycle orchestrator.
- [Sigra.Account.Deletion](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Account.Deletion.md): Account deletion lifecycle: schedule, cancel, execute.
- [Sigra.Account.EmailChange](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Account.EmailChange.md): Email change lifecycle: request, confirm, cancel.
- [Sigra.Account.PasswordChange](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Account.PasswordChange.md): Password change lifecycle: change, set for OAuth users, force change.
- [Sigra.Admin.Audit.CSVExport](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Audit.CSVExport.md): Stable CSV encoding for admin audit evidence exports.

- [Sigra.Admin.Audit.Explorer](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Audit.Explorer.md): Shared scope-safe list orchestration for admin audit explorer routes.

- [Sigra.Admin.Audit.Export](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Audit.Export.md): Shared scope-safe CSV export orchestration for admin audit explorer routes.

- [Sigra.Admin.Audit.Presenter](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Audit.Presenter.md): Canonical operator-facing audit row presentation helpers.

- [Sigra.Admin.Audit.Query](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Audit.Query.md): Admin-owned audit query wrapper for shared explorer and export semantics.

- [Sigra.Admin.Audit.QueryParams](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Audit.QueryParams.md): Whitelist-first normalization for admin audit explorer and export filters.

- [Sigra.Admin.Authorizer](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Authorizer.md): Direct-path admin authorization helpers for exports, mutations, and queries.
- [Sigra.Admin.Live.AuditIndexLive](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Live.AuditIndexLive.md): Global and organization-scoped audit explorer.

- [Sigra.Admin.Live.AuditUserLive](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Live.AuditUserLive.md): Per-user admin audit explorer for global and organization-scoped routes.

- [Sigra.Admin.Live.IndexLive](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Live.IndexLive.md): Foundation global admin entry LiveView.
- [Sigra.Admin.Live.OrganizationLive](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Live.OrganizationLive.md): Foundation organization-scoped admin entry LiveView.
- [Sigra.Admin.Live.UserShowLive](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Live.UserShowLive.md): Admin user detail surface with scope-safe session controls.

- [Sigra.Admin.Live.UsersIndexLive](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Live.UsersIndexLive.md): Admin user index for global and organization-scoped user operations.

- [Sigra.Admin.Policy](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Policy.md): Behaviour for host-owned admin access decisions.
- [Sigra.Admin.Scope](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Scope.md): Request-local resolved admin scope derived from the host's current scope.
- [Sigra.Admin.Users.Actions](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Users.Actions.md): Scope-aware admin mutations for the user detail surface.

- [Sigra.Admin.Users.DefaultHooks](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Users.DefaultHooks.md): Default no-op implementation for `Sigra.Admin.Users.Hooks`.

- [Sigra.Admin.Users.Detail](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Users.Detail.md): Scope-safe loader for the admin user detail surface.

- [Sigra.Admin.Users.Hooks](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Users.Hooks.md): Host-owned customization hooks for admin user surfaces.
- [Sigra.Admin.Users.Query](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Users.Query.md): Canonical query contract for the admin user list surface.

- [Sigra.Application](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Application.md): OTP application callback for Sigra.
- [Sigra.Credo.NoLogSafe2InLib](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Credo.NoLogSafe2InLib.md): ## Basics
- [Sigra.Credo.NoUnscopedOrgQueryInLib](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Credo.NoUnscopedOrgQueryInLib.md): ## Basics
- [Sigra.DataExport](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.DataExport.md): Behaviour for exporting user data.
- [Sigra.Delivery](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Delivery.md): Email delivery orchestration.
- [Sigra.Ecto.Types.StringList](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Ecto.Types.StringList.md): Custom Ecto type for storing lists as comma-separated strings.
- [Sigra.Email](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Email.md): Email normalization and format validation.
- [Sigra.Email.CssLint](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Email.CssLint.md): Rendered email CSS allowlist / deny-list gate backed by vendored caniemail data.
- [Sigra.EmailTemplates](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.EmailTemplates.md): Behaviour for generated email template modules.
- [Sigra.Env](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Env.md): Release-safe Mix environment detection.
- [Sigra.Error](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.md): Error types and safe message mapping for Sigra authentication.
- [Sigra.GeoIP](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.GeoIP.md): Behaviour for IP geolocation lookups.
- [Sigra.Hasher](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Hasher.md): Behaviour for password hashing implementations.
- [Sigra.Hashers.Argon2](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Hashers.Argon2.md): Argon2id password hasher implementation.
- [Sigra.Hashers.Bcrypt](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Hashers.Bcrypt.md): Bcrypt password hasher for migration from bcrypt to Argon2id.
- [Sigra.Hooks](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Hooks.md): Lifecycle hook execution engine.
- [Sigra.Identity](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Identity.md): Library struct representing an OAuth identity (provider account linked to a user).
- [Sigra.Impersonation](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Impersonation.md): Library-owned impersonation orchestration over real Sigra sessions.

- [Sigra.Install.Feature](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.Feature.md): Behaviour that every `mix sigra.install` feature module implements.
- [Sigra.Install.Features.Admin](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.Features.Admin.md): `Sigra.Install.Feature` implementation for the admin feature.
- [Sigra.Install.Features.Core](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.Features.Core.md): `Sigra.Install.Feature` implementation for v1.0's core authentication
scaffold: users, sessions, tokens, MFA, sudo, reset password, confirmation,
audit events, and (optionally) API token, JWT, and LiveView UI.
- [Sigra.Install.Features.Organizations](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.Features.Organizations.md): `Sigra.Install.Feature` implementation for the organizations feature:
multi-tenant organization support with memberships and invitations.
- [Sigra.Install.Features.Passkeys](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.Features.Passkeys.md): `Sigra.Install.Feature` implementation for the passkeys feature.
- [Sigra.Install.Injection](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.Injection.md): Structured injection descriptor for `Sigra.Install.Injector`.
- [Sigra.Install.Injector](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.Injector.md): Idempotent code injection for Sigra install generator.
- [Sigra.Install.MigrationTimestamps](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.MigrationTimestamps.md): Deterministic slot-based timestamp allocator for installer
migrations (GEN-07).
- [Sigra.Install.Report](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.Report.md): Record-as-you-go accumulator for installer decisions, rendered as
a 4-column post-install summary (GEN-05).
- [Sigra.Install.Runner](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Install.Runner.md): Generic walker over a `[Sigra.Install.Feature]` list. Feature-agnostic:
adding `Features.Organizations`, `Features.Passkeys`, or `Features.Admin`
in a later phase requires ZERO edits to this module — only a new entry
in the caller's feature list.
- [Sigra.JWT](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.JWT.md): JWT access token generation, verification, and refresh token management.
- [Sigra.JWT.ClaimsBuilder](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.JWT.ClaimsBuilder.md): Behaviour for adding custom claims to JWT access tokens.
- [Sigra.JWT.RefreshToken](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.JWT.RefreshToken.md): Refresh token management with family-based reuse detection.
- [Sigra.JWT.Signer](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.JWT.Signer.md): JWT key loading and signer creation.
- [Sigra.LiveView.AdminScope](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.LiveView.AdminScope.md): LiveView `on_mount` parity for admin scope enforcement.
- [Sigra.LiveView.OrganizationScope](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.LiveView.OrganizationScope.md): LiveView `on_mount` parallel of `Sigra.Plug.LoadOrganizationFromSlug`
(Phase 16 D-03, D-04).
- [Sigra.Lockout](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Lockout.md): Account lockout logic for brute force prevention.
- [Sigra.Mailer](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Mailer.md): Behaviour for email delivery implementations.
- [Sigra.OAuth](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.OAuth.md): OAuth orchestrator for Sigra authentication.
- [Sigra.OAuth.Callback](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.OAuth.Callback.md): Processes OAuth callback data and routes to the appropriate account action.
- [Sigra.OAuth.Smoketest](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.OAuth.Smoketest.md): Runtime support for `mix sigra.oauth.smoketest`.
- [Sigra.OAuth.Strategies](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.md): Resolves provider atoms to their corresponding strategy wrapper modules.
- [Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Apple](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Apple.md): Wraps `Assent.Strategy.Apple` for Sigra OAuth integration.
- [Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Facebook](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Facebook.md): Wraps `Assent.Strategy.Facebook` for Sigra OAuth integration.
- [Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Generic](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Generic.md): Generic fallback strategy wrapper for any Assent strategy (D-13).
- [Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Github](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Github.md): Wraps `Assent.Strategy.Github` for Sigra OAuth integration.
- [Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Google](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.OAuth.Strategies.Google.md): Wraps `Assent.Strategy.Google` for Sigra OAuth integration.
- [Sigra.Organizations](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Organizations.md): Context module for organization CRUD operations, membership management,
and safety guards.
- [Sigra.Organizations.Callbacks](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Organizations.Callbacks.md): Behaviour for organization lifecycle hook callbacks.
- [Sigra.Organizations.Invitations](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Organizations.Invitations.md): Phase 17 invitation lifecycle: `create/2`, `revoke/3`, `list_pending/2`,
`list_pending_for_user/2`. `accept/3` and `accept_with_signup/3` land
in Plan 17-05.
- [Sigra.Organizations.Query](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Organizations.Query.md): Tenant-scoping query helpers for organization-aware schemas.
- [Sigra.Organizations.Slug](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Organizations.Slug.md): Slug generation and validation for organizations.
- [Sigra.Passkeys](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Passkeys.md): Public passkey context for registration and credential management helpers.

- [Sigra.Passkeys.Authentication](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Passkeys.Authentication.md): WebAuthn authentication ceremony helpers.

- [Sigra.Passkeys.CoseKey](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Passkeys.CoseKey.md): Serialize / deserialize COSE public keys (integer-keyed maps returned by
wax_ via `Wax.AttestedCredentialData.credential_public_key`).
- [Sigra.Passkeys.Credential](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Passkeys.Credential.md): Library struct representing a WebAuthn passkey credential.
- [Sigra.Passkeys.DeviceName](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Passkeys.DeviceName.md): Resolves friendly labels for stored passkey credentials.
- [Sigra.Passkeys.Registration](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Passkeys.Registration.md): WebAuthn registration ceremony helpers.
- [Sigra.Passkeys.SignCountPolicy](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Passkeys.SignCountPolicy.md): Pure sign-count regression policy machine.

- [Sigra.PasswordPolicy](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.PasswordPolicy.md): NIST-compliant password validation and strength analysis.
- [Sigra.PasswordPolicy.CommonPasswords](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.PasswordPolicy.CommonPasswords.md): Compile-time embedded common password list for rejection checking.
- [Sigra.RateLimiter](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.RateLimiter.md): Behaviour for rate limiting implementations.
- [Sigra.RateLimiters.Hammer](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.RateLimiters.Hammer.md): Hammer 7.x rate limiter implementation.
- [Sigra.RateLimiters.Noop](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.RateLimiters.Noop.md): No-op rate limiter that always allows requests.
- [Sigra.Scope](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Scope.md): Library-side scope helpers. The `%Scope{}` struct itself is generated
into the host app — this module only provides constructors that work
via `struct/2` reflection on the host's module.
- [Sigra.Scope.Hydration](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Scope.Hydration.md): Pure scope-hydration contract shared between `Sigra.Plug.LoadActiveOrganization`
(Plug pipeline) and the generated `UserAuth.on_mount` callback (LiveView).
- [Sigra.Session](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Session.md): Struct representing an authenticated user session.
- [Sigra.SessionStore](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.SessionStore.md): Behaviour for session persistence implementations.
- [Sigra.SessionStores.Ecto](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.SessionStores.Ecto.md): Ecto-backed session store implementation.
- [Sigra.SuspiciousLogin](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.SuspiciousLogin.md): Suspicious login detection. Compares login IP against all active session IPs
for the user. Triggers on new IP during explicit login only.
- [Sigra.Telemetry](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Telemetry.md): Telemetry integration for Sigra authentication events.
- [Sigra.Token](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Token.md): Signed token generation and verification.
- [Sigra.UAParser](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.UAParser.md): Lightweight user-agent string parser.
- [Sigra.Upgrade](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Upgrade.md): Orchestrator for `mix sigra.upgrade` (Phase 18 D-08).
- [Sigra.Upgrade.Backfill](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Upgrade.Backfill.md): Library-resident backfill logic for `mix sigra.upgrade --backfill-personal-orgs`.
- [Sigra.Workers](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Workers.md): Behaviour contract for Sigra-aware background workers that require
tenant context. Pure `@callback` contract — the behaviour itself has
zero compile-time dependency on any background job library.
- [Sigra.Workers.AccountDeletion](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Workers.AccountDeletion.md): Oban worker for executing scheduled account deletions.
- [Sigra.Workers.AuditCleanup](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Workers.AuditCleanup.md): Optional Oban worker that deletes audit rows older than the configured
retention window (D-10 retention cleanup for AUDIT-03).
- [Sigra.Workers.CleanupExpiredInvitations](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Workers.CleanupExpiredInvitations.md): Optional Oban worker that hard-deletes expired, unaccepted invitation
rows past the configured retention window (D-11).
- [Sigra.Workers.EmailDelivery](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Workers.EmailDelivery.md): Oban worker for asynchronous email delivery.
- [Sigra.Workers.TokenCleanup](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Workers.TokenCleanup.md): Oban cron worker for cleaning up expired tokens.

- Core
  - [Sigra](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.md): Comprehensive authentication library for Phoenix 1.8+.
  - [Sigra.Auth](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Auth.md): Core authentication orchestrator.
  - [Sigra.Config](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Config.md): Configuration for Sigra authentication.
  - [Sigra.Crypto](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Crypto.md): Password hashing, verification, and hash upgrade operations.

- Plugs
  - [Sigra.Plug.ErrorHandler](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.ErrorHandler.md): Behaviour for handling authentication errors in the HTTP pipeline.
  - [Sigra.Plug.FetchBearer](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.FetchBearer.md): Extracts a bearer token from the Authorization header and assigns current_scope.
  - [Sigra.Plug.FetchSession](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.FetchSession.md): Fetches the current user session, enforces timeouts, and assigns `current_scope`.
  - [Sigra.Plug.ForbidDuringImpersonation](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.ForbidDuringImpersonation.md): Blocks sensitive mutations while impersonation is active.

  - [Sigra.Plug.LoadActiveOrganization](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.LoadActiveOrganization.md): Hydrates `scope.active_organization` and `scope.membership` from the caller's
`%Sigra.Session{}` (read from `conn.private[:sigra_session]`, stashed by
`Sigra.Plug.FetchSession`).
  - [Sigra.Plug.LoadOrganizationFromSlug](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.LoadOrganizationFromSlug.md): URL-driven active organization loader (Phase 16 D-03, D-04, D-13).
  - [Sigra.Plug.PasskeyChallenge](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.PasskeyChallenge.md): Plug-edge session adapter for passkey ceremony challenges.
  - [Sigra.Plug.PutActiveOrganization](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.PutActiveOrganization.md): The **single** authoritative write site for "set the active organization".
  - [Sigra.Plug.RateLimit](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.RateLimit.md): IP-based rate limiting plug for auth routes.
  - [Sigra.Plug.RequireAdminAccess](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.RequireAdminAccess.md): Resolves and enforces admin access at the Plug boundary.
  - [Sigra.Plug.RequireAuthenticated](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.RequireAuthenticated.md): Authentication gate plug that halts unauthenticated requests.
  - [Sigra.Plug.RequireMFA](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.RequireMFA.md): MFA session gate plug.
  - [Sigra.Plug.RequireMFAEnrolled](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.RequireMFAEnrolled.md): Plug that requires the current user to have MFA enrolled.
  - [Sigra.Plug.RequireMembership](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.RequireMembership.md): Halts the pipeline unless `conn.assigns[:current_scope]` has a non-nil
`active_organization` and (optionally) a membership role in the configured
`:roles` list.
  - [Sigra.Plug.RequirePasswordChange](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.RequirePasswordChange.md): Plug that redirects users who must change their password.
  - [Sigra.Plug.RequireScopes](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.RequireScopes.md): Route-level scope enforcement plug for API token authentication.
  - [Sigra.Plug.RequireSudo](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Plug.RequireSudo.md): Sudo mode gate plug that requires recent re-authentication.

- MFA
  - [Sigra.MFA](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.MFA.md): Core MFA orchestrator module.
  - [Sigra.MFA.BackupCodes](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.MFA.BackupCodes.md): Backup code generation, hashing, and atomic consumption.
  - [Sigra.MFA.Credential](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.MFA.Credential.md): Library struct representing an MFA credential (e.g., TOTP enrollment).
  - [Sigra.MFA.Lockout](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.MFA.Lockout.md): MFA-specific lockout logic, mirroring `Sigra.Lockout` pattern.
  - [Sigra.MFA.Trust](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.MFA.Trust.md): Trust cookie HMAC signing, verification, and mass revocation.

- Audit
  - [Sigra.Audit](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Audit.md): Structured audit logging for Sigra.
  - [Sigra.Audit.Assertions](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Audit.Assertions.md): Plain-function helpers for asserting on persisted audit rows in tests.
  - [Sigra.Audit.Changeset](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Audit.Changeset.md): Changeset validators for audit events.
  - [Sigra.Audit.Cursor](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Audit.Cursor.md): Base64URL cursor encoding for audit log pagination (D-13).
  - [Sigra.Audit.Query](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Audit.Query.md): Composable Ecto query builder for `audit_events`.

- Testing
  - [Sigra.Testing](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Testing.md): Test assertion helpers for Sigra authentication.

- Exceptions
  - [Sigra.Admin.Authorizer.UnauthorizedError](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Admin.Authorizer.UnauthorizedError.md)
  - [Sigra.Error.AccountLocked](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.AccountLocked.md): Raised when an account is temporarily locked due to failed attempts.
  - [Sigra.Error.AlreadyConfirmed](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.AlreadyConfirmed.md): Raised when a user's email is already confirmed.
  - [Sigra.Error.InsufficientScope](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.InsufficientScope.md): Raised when a valid token lacks required scopes.
  - [Sigra.Error.InvalidCredentials](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.InvalidCredentials.md): Raised when authentication fails due to wrong email or password.
  - [Sigra.Error.MFAError](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.MFAError.md): Raised when an MFA operation fails.
  - [Sigra.Error.MFARequired](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.MFARequired.md): Raised when JWT login requires MFA verification.
  - [Sigra.Error.OAuthError](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.OAuthError.md): Raised when an OAuth operation fails.
  - [Sigra.Error.RateLimited](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.RateLimited.md): Raised when a rate limit has been exceeded.
  - [Sigra.Error.TokenExpired](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.TokenExpired.md): Raised when a token has exceeded its time-to-live.
  - [Sigra.Error.TokenInvalid](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.TokenInvalid.md): Raised when a token is malformed, tampered, or otherwise invalid.
  - [Sigra.Error.TokenRevoked](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.TokenRevoked.md): Raised when a revoked API token or JWT refresh token is used.
  - [Sigra.Error.Unconfirmed](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Sigra.Error.Unconfirmed.md): Raised when an unconfirmed user attempts a restricted action.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix sigra.email.snapshot](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sigra.Email.Snapshot.md): Prerenders the locked 9-template × frozen-fixture matrix to HTML files
on disk so `test/example/priv/playwright/tests/email-visual.spec.ts` can
open them via `file://` URLs without requiring a running Phoenix server.
- [mix sigra.fixture.rebless_golden](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sigra.Fixture.ReblessGolden.md): Regenerates the `test/fixtures/install_golden/` baseline driven by the
`Sigra.Test.InstallFixture` harness, then prints a structured delta report
grouped by top-level directory so the operator can review what changed
without eyeballing a 20+ file raw diff.
- [mix sigra.gen.oauth](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sigra.Gen.Oauth.md): Generates OAuth support for Sigra authentication.
- [mix sigra.install](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sigra.Install.md): Generates Sigra authentication scaffold.
- [mix sigra.oauth.smoketest](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sigra.Oauth.Smoketest.md): Adopter-side real-credential check. Boots a tiny callback endpoint on
`127.0.0.1`, prints the authorize URL, and waits for you to complete the
provider flow in a browser.
- [mix sigra.uat.report](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sigra.Uat.Report.md): Generates machine-readable manifests and human-readable reports for Sigra's
committed UAT evidence bundles.
- [mix sigra.upgrade](https://sigra.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sigra.Upgrade.md): Upgrades a Sigra-installed app from an older schema version to the
current library version (Phase 18 D-08).
